channel.title: Risk alerts: Korean small and mid-cap filings
channel.description: New risk alerts filings from Korean small and mid caps.

item.title: Hyungji I&C filed for an injunction in Seoul Southern District Court to suspend Korea Exchange's delisting and administrative issue designation decisions.
Korea Steel Wire's shares were halted on Nov 6, 2026 at 15:14 over a bonus issue of 10% or more, resuming Nov 9.
KOSDAQ halted trading in Pino (피노) common shares on 2026-11-05 to determine whether a backdoor listing applies and requirements are met.
